rows: What is titanium white's RI and why does it matter?
RI 2.70–2.73 (rutile) — highest of any white; 4× more scattering per unit than ZnO → maximum opacity
18-π-electron aromatic macrocycle — largest stable aromatic system in common use; photons absorbed too low-energy to break the system
What is quinacridone's color determined by?
Crystal polymorph — same molecule, different packing → different π-stacking interactions → different effective HOMO-LUMO gap → different color
How do quantum dots achieve different colors from the same material?
Quantum confinement: Eg increases as particle shrinks → smaller = wider band gap = higher energy = shorter λ = bluer
Not chromophore absorption — geometric light trap in carbon nanotube forest; multiple reflections absorb all incident light
Why do interference pigments shift color with angle?
Thin-film interference — constructive interference wavelength depends on path difference = 2nt which changes with incident angle
PB = Pigment Blue, 15 = copper phthalocyanine family, :3 = β polymorph (green-shade blue) — standard Color Index notation
Why does TiO₂ sometimes degrade paint?
Anatase polymorph photocatalyzes organic matter under UV — modern pigment uses rutile + SiO₂/Al₂O₃ coating to suppress this
